title: Eggplant Parmigiana Towers
subtitle: with classic tomato sauce, mozzarella and basil
description: Salted and roasted eggplant slices stacked into small towers with mozzarella, basil and parmesan and served in a classic tomato sauce.

steps.text: Salt the eggplant slices (1 cm thick) with coarse salt, lay them on a tray lined with paper towel and leave to sweat for 30 minutes.

Meanwhile, make the sauce: heat the olive oil and garlic in a large pan and, when the garlic begins to set but before it browns, add the halved cherry tomatoes, season with coarse salt, stir and cook for 5 minutes. Add the canned tomatoes and basil leaves, season, bring to the boil, lower the heat and cook, stirring, for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 220°C. Pat the eggplant dry with paper towel, arrange in a single layer on trays greased with olive oil and bake for about 10 minutes until lightly browned.

Build the towers: stack the eggplant slices with thin slices of mozzarella, basil leaves and a little parmesan between the layers, set them in a baking dish with a little of the sauce and bake until the mozzarella melts. Serve in the remaining warm tomato sauce.
